article_title: Donegal: Brown bears adjusting to new life in Irish countryside

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: A plan to return Irish bears to Russia
The difficult five-year rescue of Bu and Tyapa and their recovery at a Donegal sanctuary
A new circus opening in County Donegal
A study comparing wild bears and zoo animals
tasks.correct_answer: The difficult five-year rescue of Bu and Tyapa and their recovery at a Donegal sanctuary
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת במסע החילוץ המורכב של בו וטיאפה מרוסיה ובהסתגלות ובהחלמה שלהם במקלט Wild Ireland בדוניגול.

tasks.prompt: What serious health problem did blood tests reveal after the bears were rescued?
options: Broken bones
Kidney problems linked to long-term dehydration
Loss of sight
A contagious lung disease
tasks.correct_answer: Kidney problems linked to long-term dehydration
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בדיקות הדם הראו בעיות כליה חמורות שנקשרו להתייבשות ממושכת.

tasks.prompt: Why was the original route through Ukraine abandoned?
options: The bears' crates were too large for the roads.
Irish officials rejected the route.
Russia's invasion of Ukraine made the route impossible.
The sanctuary chose a shorter sea journey.
tasks.correct_answer: Russia's invasion of Ukraine made the route impossible.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הפלישה הרוסית לאוקראינה בפברואר 2022 הפכה את מסלול ההובלה המקורי דרך אוקראינה לבלתי אפשרי.

tasks.prompt: Which route finally brought the bears to Ireland?
options: Dagestan–Kyiv–London–Donegal
Moscow–Paris–Belfast
St Petersburg–Istanbul–Cork
Moscow–Abu Dhabi–Dublin
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הדובים טסו ממוסקבה דרך אבו דאבי לדבלין והגיעו לאירלנד באוגוסט 2026.

tasks.prompt: What does “malnourished” mean in the description of the rescued bears?
options: In poor health because they had not received enough proper food
Unable to live near other animals
Trained to perform for visitors
Temporarily sleepy after medication
tasks.correct_answer: In poor health because they had not received enough proper food
tasks.explanation_hebrew: malnourished מתאר מצב של תת־תזונה: בריאות לקויה עקב מחסור במזון מתאים ומספק.

tasks.prompt: Why does the team hide food around the bears' habitat?
options: To keep visitors away from feeding times
To test whether the bears can count
To make cleaning the enclosure easier
To encourage foraging, natural behaviour and confidence
tasks.correct_answer: To encourage foraging, natural behaviour and confidence
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הסתרת המזון מעודדת את הדובים לחפש וללקט בעצמם, וכך מחזקת התנהגות טבעית וביטחון בסביבה החדשה.

tasks.prompt: Name two ways Bu and Tyapa's health improved after arriving at Wild Ireland.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני שיפורים בריאותיים מפורשים מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Follow-up blood tests showed normal kidney function.

tasks.prompt: Summarise why the rescue took five years and how the bears finally reached Donegal.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להזכיר את תנאי הפתיחה הקשים, את שיבושי המסלול עקב שני עימותים, את הטיפול והבידוד ואת מסלול הטיסה הסופי.
expected_points: McLaughlin committed to rescuing the bears in 2021, but the Ukraine war blocked the original route.
A later Middle East route was disrupted by conflict involving Iran and airspace closures.
The bears were removed from their cages, treated and quarantined at Tiger House.
They eventually travelled from Moscow via Abu Dhabi to Dublin and then to Wild Ireland.

tasks.prompt: How does the new habitat support both the bears' physical and psychological recovery? Use evidence from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין מרחב, טבע, מים, מקומות מסתור והעשרה התנהגותית לבין שיפור גופני ונפשי.
expected_points: The habitat provides woodland, water and room to explore.
Sheltered areas let the bears retreat from public view.
Hidden food encourages natural foraging behaviour.
Staff observed better health, growing confidence and mental improvement.

tasks.prompt: Write a brief sanctuary update for visitors describing the bears' progress without ignoring their traumatic past.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: העדכון צריך לשלב לפחות שתי עובדות על עברם ושתי עובדות על ההתקדמות שלהם, בניסוח מכבד ומאוזן.
expected_points: Mentions cramped cages, malnutrition, dehydration or psychological trauma.
Describes gains in weight, coat condition, kidney function or confidence.
Uses respectful language and avoids claiming recovery is complete.
